guitar.modelsText: Fender Mustang / Fender Jaguar / Martin D-18E
guitar.notes: Confirmed — Kurt Cobain's Mustang, Jaguar, and the Martin D-18E from MTV Unplugged are all extremely well documented.

tone.target: dry Nirvana grunge crunch with slight chorus wash
tone.profile: dry Nirvana grunge crunch with slight chorus wash
tone.summary: A tight signal chain using Green OD for initial crunch, followed by the US Deluxe amp model to capture the classic Nirvana 'grunge bite' with subtle chorus added for wash.
corrections: Add grunge bite, not indie clean
